messages:
Amelia: FYI I'm starting a quick migration guide for the v1->v2 API swap and a separate model-alias section. Want PR owners and snippet owners to review — going to push a draft to the docs repo in ~30m.
Mike: Awesome, thanks. Quick question — any snippet changes that will break existing SDKs? we should call out shims/compat notes up front.
Amelia: Yes — streaming callback param renamed in JS/TS and a couple of embed param renames. Plan to add side-by-side v1 -> v2 snippet blocks and a 'compatibility' subsection.
Jen: Please add link ownership checklist too. Last time we had a PR that updated a canonical doc and left several redirects stale.
Amelia: Good call @Jen — I propose we require a 'docs-links' label and at least one owner in the PR description when touching examples/redirects. I'll add a checklist template.
Sam: I'll take Ruby/Rails snippets ownership. Ping me when the draft is live. Also, can we include a short example showing model fallback routing for embedded vs text endpoints? customers hit that edgecase.
Amelia: Yep — will add a small diagram + example config for fallback policy. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — contains snippets and a short migration checklist. Please comment inline.
Mike: Left 2 very small nits. One is in the JS code block where the example still uses client.createCompletion — should be client.responses.create for v2.
Jen: Also add a short note about embed vector-dim swaps: show the common error message and remediation steps (how to reindex + detect mismatch). That helps support triage.
docs-bot: PR #4821 opened by Amelia — CI: docs-lint passed, smoke-tests failed (1).
Amelia: Thx bot. Sam can you take a look at the smoke failure? looks like a fenced codeblock language tag slipped through and broke the snippet harness.
Sam: On it — failing test is markdown-snippet linter complaining about an unescaped backtick in the ruby example. Will push a fix in a few.
Jen: Also can we put 'snippet-owners: @Sam, @Jen' in the PR body so we have clear ownership for future fixes?
Amelia: Done. Updated PR description and added the 'docs-links' label. Will merge once smoke passes and I get 2 approvals.
Mike: :thumbsup:
Sam: Fixed the backtick escape and pushed. Re-ran smoke locally — green.
docs-bot: PR #4821 CI: all checks passed.
Amelia: Merged. Thanks all. I'll follow up with a tiny doc on rollback guidance for Dedicated customers (A/B rollback pattern) and file a ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DOCS-1023
Jen: Nice, thanks — will add a short support triage note to the embed-dim section.
Mike: Thanks everyone, smooth ship.
Amelia: Closing loop here — if anyone spots a stale redirect after next release ping #docs and I'll open a redirect PR.
summary: Coordination thread for v1->v2 migration guide, snippet fixes, link ownership, and PR 4821 workflow
